useCases.title: AI-Enabled Chest X-Ray Screening for Pulmonary Tuberculosis
useCases.authority: State National Health Mission (NHM) & State TB Cell (NTEP)
useCases.targetFacility: Mobile Diagnostic Vans & Rural District TB Centres across 12 High-Burden Districts
useCases.clinicalModality: Digital Radiography (CXR) - Computer-Aided Detection (CAD) for Pulmonary TB
useCases.targetEndUsers: Medical Officers (MBBS), Radiographers & NTEP Senior Treatment Supervisors
useCases.autonomyLevel: Triage & Worklist Prioritization (Non-autonomous; flags suspicious lesions for sputum/CBNAAT test)
useCases.hardwareContext: Portable battery-powered Digital Radiography (DR) machines installed in all-terrain vans
useCases.connectivityProfile: Intermittent 2G/4G cellular networks; requiring zero-connectivity offline edge processing

complianceProfile.abdmRequirement: M1 (ABHA verification) & Nikshay Portal API integration
complianceProfile.dataLocalization: Mandatory sovereign hosting on MeitY empanelled CSP

useCases.governmentTestingNotes: Validated with simulated State TB Officer and State NHM Procurement Committee. Highlighted the necessity of offline local inference to prevent workflow halt in tribal zones where mobile signals are unavailable.

useCases.title: Autonomous Diabetic Retinopathy Screening at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs (AAM)
useCases.authority: State Directorate of Health Services (NCD Division)
useCases.targetFacility: 250 Sub-Health Centre (SHC) level Ayushman Arogya Mandirs
useCases.clinicalModality: Non-Mydriatic Fundus Photography with automated grading (Referable vs. Non-Referable DR)
useCases.targetEndUsers: Community Health Officers (CHOs) and Auxiliary Nurse Midwives (ANMs)
useCases.autonomyLevel: Autonomous Screening Triage with tele-ophthalmology referral for referable stages
useCases.procurementMechanism: Open E-Tender (State Medical Services Corporation QCBS 70:30)
useCases.hardwareContext: Handheld non-mydriatic fundus cameras paired with Android/Windows edge tablets

complianceProfile.cdscoClass: Class C Software as a Medical Device
complianceProfile.abdmRequirement: M1 (ABHA creation), M2 (HFR clinic registry), M3 (FHIR R4 DiagnosticReport)

useCases.governmentTestingNotes: Feedback highlighted the critical requirement for real-time image quality feedback: CHOs require the software to flag ungradable images immediately so the patient does not leave before a re-take is performed.

useCases.title: Maternal & Neonatal High-Risk Labor Room Triage System
useCases.authority: State Maternal & Child Health Directorate (LaQshya Program)
useCases.targetFacility: 18 High-Volume District Hospital Labor Rooms and SNCUs
useCases.clinicalModality: Continuous Multi-Parameter Vitals, Electronic Partograph & Fetal Heart Rate Monitoring
useCases.targetEndUsers: Duty Staff Nurses, Obstetricians, Pediatricians & Medical Officers
useCases.autonomyLevel: Assistive Clinical Decision Support (Real-time audible & visual early warning indicators)
useCases.procurementMechanism: State E-Procurement Portal (QCBS 80:20 with Proof-of-Concept Pilot)
useCases.hardwareContext: Bedside touch terminals and central nursing station telemetry monitors

complianceProfile.cdscoClass: Class C / Class D Software as a Medical Device
complianceProfile.abdmRequirement: M1, M2, M3 integration with Hospital Information Management System (HIMS)
complianceProfile.dataLocalization: Strict zero-cloud on-premise hospital intranet hosting

useCases.governmentTestingNotes: Clinicians demanded rigorous alarm-fatigue mitigation clauses to prevent constant false-positive beeping in crowded labor rooms, as well as clear legal disclaimers ensuring doctor primacy.

useCases.title: Real-Time ICU Sepsis & Clinical Deterioration Early Warning System
useCases.authority: Autonomous State Medical College & Tertiary Referral Hospital
useCases.clinicalModality: Multi-stream physiological telemetry, lab feeds (arterial blood gas, CBC), and vitals NLP
useCases.targetEndUsers: Intensivists, Critical Care Fellows, and Senior Nursing Supervisors
useCases.autonomyLevel: Assistive Early Warning System (Predictive risk score for septic shock 4-6 hours in advance)
useCases.procurementMechanism: Open Tender Two-Bid System (Technical + Financial QCBS)
useCases.hardwareContext: Multi-vendor bedside monitors linked to a central server via HL7 gateway
useCases.connectivityProfile: Dedicated Gigabit Medical Intranet; air-gapped from public internet

complianceProfile.abdmRequirement: M3 compliant EHR export via FHIR Encounter & Observation resources

useCases.governmentTestingNotes: Evaluators strongly emphasized multi-vendor physiological monitor compatibility to ensure the state is not forced to replace existing Philips or Mindray equipment to accommodate the AI tool.
